v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

text.la: Tecum princípium * in die virtútis tuæ, in splendóribus sanctórum, ex útero ante lucíferum génui te.
text.en: Thine shall be the dominion * in the day of thy power, amid the brightness of the saints, from the womb, before the day-star, have I begotten thee.

text.la: Redemptiónem * misit Dóminus pópulo suo: mandávit in ætérnum testaméntum suum.
text.en: The Lord sent redemption * unto His people, He hath commanded His covenant for ever.

text.la: Exórtum est * in ténebris lumen rectis corde: miséricors, et miserátor, et iustus Dóminus.
text.en: Unto the upright there ariseth * light in the darkness; the Lord is gracious, and full of compassion, and righteous.

text.la: Apud Dóminum * misericórdia, et copiósa apud eum redémptio.
text.en: With the Lord * there is mercy, and with Him is plenteous redemption.

text.la: De fructu * ventris tui ponam super sedem tuam.
text.en: Of the fruit * of thy body will I set upon thy throne.

text.la: Vidi supra montem Sion Agnum stantem, et cum eo centum quadragínta quátuor míllia habéntes nomen eius, et nomen Patris eius scriptum in fróntibus suis.
text.en: Lo, a lamb stood upon mount Sion, and with him an hundred forty-four thousand, having his name, and the name of his Father, written on their foreheads.

v.la: Sub throno Dei omnes Sancti clamant.
v.en: From beneath the throne of God all the saints cry out.

r.en: Avenge thou our blood, O our God.

text.la: Innocéntes pro Christo * infántes occísi sunt, ab iníquo rege lacténtes interfécti sunt: ipsum sequúntur Agnum sine mácula, et dicunt semper: Glória tibi, Dómine.
text.en: Innocent babies * were slain for Christ, sucklings were killed by a wicked king. Now they follow the Lamb without spot and cry without ceasing, Glory be to thee, O Lord.

text.la: Deus, cuius hodiérna die præcónium Innocéntes Mártyres non loquéndo, sed moriéndo conféssi sunt: ómnia in nobis vitiórum mala mortífica; ut fidem tuam, quam lingua nostra lóquitur, étiam móribus vita fateátur.
text.en: O God, whose praise the martyred Innocents on this day confessed, not by speaking, but by dying, destroy all the evils of sin in us, that our life also may proclaim in deeds, thy faith which our tongues profess.

text.la: Hódie Christus natus est: hódie Salvátor appáruit: hódie in terra canunt Angeli, lætántur Archángeli: hódie exsúltant iusti, dicéntes: Glória in excélsis Deo, allelúia.
text.en: This day the Christ is born this day the Saviour is appeared; this day the Angels sing praise in the earth and the Archangels rejoice; this day the righteous are glad and say: Glory to God in the highest. Alleluia.

v.en: The Lord hath made known, alleluia.

text.la: Concéde, quǽsumus, omnípotens Deus: ut nos Unigéniti tui nova per carnem Natívitas líberet; quos sub peccáti iugo vetústa sérvitus tenet.
text.en: Grant, we beseech thee, almighty God, that the new birth of thy Only-begotten Son as man may set us free, who are held by the old bondage under the yoke of sin.
